notes: orchestrate is the PM orchestrator: it triages a request (type NEW_FEATURE/ENHANCEMENT/BUG_FIX/UI_CHANGE/REFACTOR + complexity), creates a PLAN and registry entries, picks a workflow (Full SDLC / Bug Fix / Enhancement / Simple), and delegates each step to a role agent via the Agent tool, verifying artifacts between phases. Evaluate whether it classifies then delegates via spawns and pauses at approval gates, rather than executing the work itself.

evals.prompt: Coordinate the work to add CSV export to the reports module — figure out what's needed and hand the pieces to the right agents.
evals.expected_output: Step 0 context detection + triage classifies this as ENHANCEMENT / Medium, creates docs/plans/PLAN-[feature]-[date].md and a PLAN-REGISTRY entry, selects the Enhancement workflow (gap analysis -> architect-agent delta design -> developer-agent -> code-review-agent -> unit-test-agent), spawns each via the Agent tool, verifies the artifact after each phase, and pauses at approval gates. Does not write the export code itself.

evals.prompt: Manage this like a mini-project: it touches the REST API, the DB schema, and the Vue frontend. Plan it and delegate the parts to the right specialists.
evals.expected_output: Triages as a multi-domain NEW_FEATURE/Medium+ task, optionally runs the Planning Council (ba-agent + architect-agent concurrently) for Medium+, creates the PLAN + registry entries, then delegates design/implementation/testing to architect-agent, developer-agent, and test agents, verifying each artifact. Orchestrator coordinates and gates; it does not code.

evals.prompt: Read folder.service.ts and explain what the soft-delete filter does.
evals.expected_output: A direct read-and-explain request that needs no delegation: answers inline from the file. Should NOT trigger orchestrate — no Agent spawns, no docs/plans/PLAN-*.md created, no registry writes.
